text:
maddie: Morning async — quick status update. Onboarded mamba-v1 (smallq) to staging and ran the standard promptset/evals. Seeing a spike in Spanish hallucination score on convo_long_spanish set (precision down ~8%).

ryan: Thanks! Do you have the eval run id? I can grab examples and triage.

maddie: run id: mamba-stg-2024-06-12-42. Pushed raw outputs to S3: s3://redwood-evals/mamba/mamba-stg-2024-06-12-42.jsonl.

julia: I pulled a few cases — looks like KV cache warming mismatch for longer contexts. Might be related to the smallq quantization path.

maddie: noted. Re-ran with KV warmup enabled + longer prefix, results improved locally. Will share diff.

kevin: @maddie can you also open a quick CR for the quant flag change? I'll do a fast review today. If it's just toggling warmup flag we can ship a hotfix to staging.

maddie: yep opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-runtime/pull/1284 — tiny change, adds config kv_warmup: true for smallq staging profiles.

ryan: tagging @eval-bot to run the regression suite after the PR lands.

eval-bot: queued regression run (id: reg-8732). Expected duration ~12m. Will post results. :robot_face:

maddie: blocker — one Spanish prompt still produces an extra deterministic token at the very start, looks like tokenization edge-case. cc @kevin for tokenizer sanity check.

kevin: can you paste example output and input?

maddie: input: "¿Cuál es la capital de España y dame una lista breve de sitios para visitar?"
output (staging): "Madrid..." (leading null char).

julia: weird — that looks like a stray byte from our preprocessing pipeline. Maybe the promptset export inserted a non-printable. I can run a scrub step.

maddie: please do, thanks. I'll hold off on promoting to dedicated until both hallucination and leading byte are cleared.

ryan: FYI I left a small comment on the PR about test coverage for warmup path. Not blocking.

kevin: will review PR in next hour. If green, we can merge and trigger reg-8732 to re-run.

eval-bot: regression run reg-8732: initial results posted to https://console.redwood/evals/reg-8732. Summary: spanish_hallucination +8% (worse), token_leading_null: 1/200 cases. Detailed diff attached.

maddie: thanks — julia can you run the scrub and re-export promptset, then I'll re-run local smoke and push a replacement file to S3.

julia: on it. running scrub now: ```
> cat prompts/spanish_convo.jsonl | python scripts/sanitize_prompts.py --strip-nonprint
> aws s3 cp - s3://redwood-evals/mamba/mamba-stg-2024-06-12-42-clean.jsonl
```

julia: scrub done and uploaded. new run id when re-eval: mamba-stg-2024-06-12-42-reclean.

maddie: kicked an eval: `evalctl run --model mamba-v1 --prompts s3://redwood-evals/mamba/mamba-stg-2024-06-12-42-clean.jsonl --tags warmup-test`

deploy-bot: build mamba-v1-smallq (sha: f1a2b3c) deployed to staging slot-7.

eval-bot: queued run (id: reg-8732-r2) for warmup-test. ETA ~10m.

ryan: small logistics note — I'll be OOO afternoon, ping @kevin for any follow-ups.

maddie: perfect. Today: finish triage, push hotfix PR, and validate re-run. Blockers: PR review + final scrub confirmation.

kevin: ack, I'll keep an eye and try to review ASAP. :thumbsup:

maddie: thanks all. I'll post final pass when reg-8732-r2 finishes.
